reviews.notes: Exact mapped Q3087620 bridge axis and published 73.3 × 16.7 m exterior reviewed against independent current GSI DEM1A ground. West road reference at [135.7712849734,35.0090017595] is 41.714 m; native road endpoint 4.55 m gives model origin approximately 37.16 m. The independent east road plateau at native X 40 m is 41.733 m. All eight current production terrain images inspected, including OSM carriageway/sidewalk approach geometry: clipped connector surfaces meet both modeled road ends without duplicate bridge spans or tiny inferred connector piers. The endpoint rays +2.25/+0.73 m are over the steep abutment-bank faces, not the upper road plateau, and are retained. The 1 m laser DEM preserves 6,630 null river cells; unknown riverbed is omitted and never filled or treated as zero. Host must supply fine terrain and sampleStructureTerrain using the same bank reference consistently across all resident tiles; without this callback the extended model remains deferred and its procedural fallback stays visible. No underwater footing/bathymetry survey or universal compatibility with coarse global DEM is claimed.
